title: Implement semantic pricing and Decimal ledger
description: Add a checked-in versioned price snapshot, frozen run-level semantic budget spec, canonical Decimal reservation ledger, usage reconciliation, unknown-outcome handling, and exhaustive unit specifications.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implementation started test-first. Scope: exact Decimal-string pricing and ledger core only, including immutable model pricing, bounded plans, conservative reservation, usage settlement, unknown outcome retention, pre-contact cancellation, and replay idempotency. No semantic provider calls or existing float budget reuse.

comments.text: Green implementation evidence: added an exact Decimal-string semantic ledger and checked-in pricing snapshot for openai:gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07 under pricing version openai-2025-08-07-v1. The ledger covers bounded plans, deterministic reservation identity, noncached worst-case reservation, cached actual settlement, unknown-outcome retention, pre-contact release, replay conflicts, zero/equality boundaries, and multiple targets. Focused semantic, Report, and portfolio suites pass: 138 passed with one unrelated SQLAlchemy deprecation warning.
